brief:
Spectators interrupted the Nations League football match between Ireland and Austria in Dublin on Thursday with two brief demonstrations supporting Palestine, Al-Monitor reported. In the 19th minute, fans threw tennis balls decorated with Palestinian flag stickers onto the field, halting play.

The match faced a second interruption from the same protest action, though details of the timing and nature of the second stoppage were not specified in the report.
dek: The Nations League football match between Ireland and Austria in Dublin on Thursday was twice briefly interrupted by demonstrations in support of Palestine. In the 19th minute, spectators threw tennis balls covered in Palestinian flag stickers onto the field.
title: Protesters halt Ireland-Austria match twice with Gaza demonstrations
